transcript: The patient is a 58-year-old male with type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension. He reports fatigue and occasional chest pain. He is currently on metformin and lisinopril. His last HbA1c was 8.2 percent. No history of stroke.
Patient is a 34-year-old female. She denies asthma and no history of COPD. She presents with shortness of breath and cough. She is taking albuterol as needed.
The patient has no personal history of cancer. Family history significant for breast cancer in the mother. Patient currently has fatigue and weight loss.
Patient presents with depression and insomnia. She reports sleeping only 4 hours per night. She is on sertraline 100mg daily. She denies any suicidal ideation.

The patient has congestive heart failure managed with metoprolol. Rules out myocardial infarction at this time. No evidence of atrial fibrillation. He reports shortness of breath on exertion and palpitations.
Patient has chronic kidney disease stage 3. She is without chest pain today. Blood pressure is elevated at 145 over 92. She takes amlodipine. No diabetes.
Patient has rheumatoid arthritis confirmed by serology. She is on methotrexate and prednisone. She reports joint pain and swelling in both hands. Free of cardiac disease.
65-year-old male with Parkinson disease. He reports tremor and difficulty walking. He takes levodopa. His father had Alzheimer disease. No history of epilepsy or seizures.

The patient has obesity, type 2 diabetes, and hypertension. She denies any history of kidney disease or liver disease. She is on atorvastatin for high cholesterol and omeprazole for reflux. Her BMI is 38.
Patient has severe COPD and is on fluticasone and salmeterol. Absence of asthma noted. He denies smoking currently. Reports chronic cough and fatigue. Negative for lung cancer.
Patient presents with hypothyroidism on levothyroxine. She also has depression managed with escitalopram. She reports weight gain and fatigue. No evidence of cardiovascular disease.
The patient never had epilepsy or seizures. He does not have diabetes. He presents with asthma and is on albuterol. Mother had hypertension. Father had type 2 diabetes.
Patient had a stroke 3 years ago and has been on aspirin and clopidogrel. He denies recurrent chest pain. Blood pressure today is 138 over 82. He reports dizziness and fatigue.
Patient has relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. She is without active exacerbation today. Reports tingling in her hands and blurred vision. No history of cancer. Her sister had lupus.
Patient has Crohn disease managed with azathioprine. He reports abdominal pain and weight loss. Rules out colorectal cancer at this time. No evidence of liver disease.

Patient has atrial fibrillation on apixaban. His last echocardiogram showed preserved ejection fraction. He denies chest pain at rest. Reports palpitations and occasional shortness of breath. No history of stroke.
Patient has iron deficiency anemia on ferrous sulfate. She reports fatigue and dizziness. Family history negative for sickle cell. She denies shortness of breath at rest.
The patient has anxiety disorder managed with buspirone. She also suffers from chronic migraines treated with sumatriptan. She reports insomnia. Free of depression. No family history of migraine.
Patient had breast cancer resection 2 years ago and is now on anastrozole. She reports fatigue and joint pain. Negative for recurrence on last imaging. No evidence of metastasis.

Patient is a 22-year-old with type 1 diabetes mellitus since childhood on insulin pump. HbA1c is 7.1 percent. She denies any episodes of severe hypoglycemia recently. Reports occasional dizziness. No history of kidney disease.
